cc:Work.dc:title: communication-study-nyquist-eye
cc:Work.dc:description: Three-symbol analytic PAM demonstration with symbols (1,-1,1) at (-T,0,T). p(t)=sinc(t/T) has zero neighboring contributions at t=0 and output -1; q(t)=sinc(0.6t/T) is bandlimited to 0.3/T, has neighboring contributions sinc(0.6) each, and output approximately 0.0091023. Both pulse peaks are normalized to one; this is not a claim of unit-gain-channel waveform scaling. The figure illustrates sample interference, not a measured eye diagram.
